Subject: Audio recording of the Earnings Conference Call for Q1 – FY2027 results, organized 
on August 07, 2026. 
 
We are providing hereunder the “Link” to access the Audio Recording of Earnings Conference 
Call organized on August 07, 2026, post declaration of the UnAudited Financial Results of the 
Company for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026, for your information and record. 
 
Link: Earnings call audio Recording Q1 FY 27.mp3

on following path: https://www.vijayadiagnostic.com/> Investors> Results Reports & 
Presentation> Financial Results> FY 2026-27> Earnings Call Audio FY 2026-27 Q1 
(https://www.vijayadiagnostic.com/investors/financial-results). 
 
Kindly take the same on record. 
 
Thanking You, 
 
Yours Faithfully 
For Vijaya Diagnostic Centre Limited
